summary.en: Glenmark combines regional licenses for oncology medicines with IGI's earlier-stage antibody research. Partnered programs drive much of the clinical portfolio.
summary.zh: Glenmark将肿瘤药物的区域授权与IGI的早期抗体研究相结合。合作项目构成临床组合的主体。

ind.en: Regional oncology filings; also resectable NSCLC Phase 3
ind.zh: 区域肿瘤申报;另有可切除NSCLC III期

ind.en: HER2-expressing cancers; also platinum-resistant ovarian cancer Phase 3
ind.zh: 表达HER2的癌症;另有铂耐药卵巢癌III期

next.en: First commercial launch anticipated in second half of company FY2027
next.zh: 预计在公司FY2027下半年首次商业上市

ind.zh: 复发/难治性多发性骨髓瘤

next.zh: ASH大会公布更新的I期数据

watch.en: AbbVie co-develops ISB-2001; IGI retains milestone and royalty economics.
watch.zh: AbbVie共同开发ISB-2001;IGI保留里程碑付款和特许权使用费权益。

watch.en: STAR-0310 rights returned after BioCryst's acquisition of Astria; IGI seeks a new path.
watch.zh: BioCryst收购Astria后,STAR-0310的权利已返还;IGI正寻求新的路径。

watch.en: LAD191 Phase 2 data are expected in 2027.
watch.zh: LAD191 II期数据预计于2027年公布。

sources: Envafolimab license and PD-L1 target, January 2024
gaps: Pipeline charts are images and dated April 5, 2026, older than June 2026; November management discussion supplies current stages.
Trastuzumab rezetecan's filed indications are not specified; ovarian cancer is a separate Phase 3 program.
STAR-0310 rights returned November 4; development path is under evaluation.
ISB-2001 monotherapy is phase 1; a separate combination phase 1/2 study is also active.

Envafolimab PD-L1 mechanism uses the January 2024 company license announcement, older than June 2026. Lead filed regional indication remains unverified. Launch expectations retain Indian company fiscal years without conversion to calendar dates. ISB-880 and STAR-0310 origins remain unverified; no dated next event was established for trastuzumab rezetecan or STAR-0310.
